text:
maya: scheduling a small deploylet 20:30 UTC to flip router header flags + runtime micropatch. Need quick cross-team signoff (API, runtime, router, console). No DB migrations.

taylor: do we have a version pin for runtime? want to avoid rolling edge variants.

maya: pinning runtime rtf-3.0.7-hotfix, api stays on api-3.0.0 but we'll bump to api-3.0.1-canary. Router change is config toggle 'header_sidecar=true' behind rollout. Console: monitoring-only.

raja: suggest canary cadence: 3% for 8m, 15% for 12m, then 50% for 10m then full. keep autoscaler disabled during canary to avoid noisy scale.

emma: agreement on autoscaler—add note to opsbot to freeze scale during canary window.

maya: risk notes: header flip can increase request fanout to runtime (extra header processing path). watch CPU p95, api error spikes, and tokenization latency.

raja: rollback rules proposal: immediate rollback if 1) api 5xxs > 0.8% for 3m OR 2) p95 latency > baseline + 300ms sustained 2m OR 3) runtime CPU p99 > 90% for 1m. Otherwise pause and escalate.

maya: add manual rollback if customer-facing errors observed in after-call ops report (across >2 regions).

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled deploylet starting 1764559800 (2026-10-03 20:30 UTC). Steps:
- preflight checks: configs, variant IDs, smoke tests
- update runtime pin to rtf-3.0.7-hotfix on dedicated pool
- deploy api-3.0.1-canary to 3%
- flip router header_sidecar=true for 3%
- monitor 8m, if green ramp to 15%
Commands:
`/deploylet --pin runtime:rtf-3.0.7-hotfix --canary api:3.0.1-canary --router-toggle header_sidecar --cadence 8m,12m,10m`

taylor: variant ids pls? need to validate checksums.

maya: rtf-3.0.7-hotfix@sha256:dd77ee, api-3.0.1-canary@sha256:ff88aa, router-toggle cfg:sidecar-toggle-v1

emma: opsbot set autoscaler freeze and set transient cpu guardrail for runtime pool before canary. Also create short TTL cache bypass to avoid stale header behavior.

opsbot: opsbot: autoscaler frozen for pool runtime-dedicated until 1764563400. CPU guardrail configured: emergency-scale-down suppressed, guard threshold p99 CPU 88%. TTL cache-bypass enabled for header path.

raja: i'll wire up a light synthetic that hits header path and baseline compare. synthbot pls run once preflight and mark baseline.

synthbot: synthbot: preflight synthetic executed. Baselines recorded: p95=220ms, p99=420ms, error-rate=0.06%.

maya: release note short: "Deploylet 1764559999: runtime hotfix + api canary, router header_sidecar rollout. Canary cadence 3%->15%->50%->100%. Rollback criteria: elevated 5xx, latency increase, runtime CPU pressure." 

taylor: who owns rollback button and comms?

maya: rollback lead = taylor, postmortem owner = raja. escalation: ops oncall + eng-releases.

taylor: I'm on standby 20:20-21:00 UTC. i'll hit rollback if thresholds exceeded.

raja: quick checklist before we start: 1) confirm variant ids 2) freeze autoscaler 3) synthetic baseline 4) dashboards + pager alerts 5) runbook pinned to thread. all set?

maya: all set from my side. tagging deploybot to execute at scheduled time. thanks. :raised_hands:

deploybot: deploybot: acknowledged. will post status updates in-thread during rollout and on completion.

opsbot: opsbot: reminder scheduled 1764559800 -> run preflight hooks 15m before start.

maya: locking plan. if anyone spots anything missing, shout now.
taylor: nothing else. ready.

raja: ready too. good luck :)
